method: partitioned (Frisch-Waugh) normal equations on the centred calibration design; algebraically identical to numpy.linalg.lstsq on [1, Z] for a full-rank design
reference: numpy.linalg.lstsq(..., rcond=None) on the explicit [1, Z] design, recomputed independently
rank_deficiency_rule: eigenvalues of the centred Gram matrix; sqrt(min/max) <= max(n_prot, m+1)*eps -> J_search = +infinity and SEARCH_PROXY_RANK_DEFICIENT; NEVER inadmissibility
